posts.text:
NVIDIA used our MolmoSpaces benchmark to evaluate GR00T 2, alongside RoboCasa365, RoboLab, & RoboDojo. Thanks 
@NVIDIARobotics
!

MolmoSpaces is open, so any team can test their robot policies on the same simulated homes, objects, & tasks:
